verdict.rationale: Trello documents a REST API with API keys, authorization flows, and Batch, Search and Webhooks endpoints, but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable machine-readable spec (OpenAPI or equivalent). Probes of common OpenAPI and Swagger paths on the developer site all returned 404. Human-readable REST docs are adjacent and do not satisfy the story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
